steps.label: The two varieties
lines: Two high yielding, disease resistant wheat
steps.why: Both are semi-dwarf wheats derived from the Mexican varieties Borlaug developed, which is why they arrived together.
common_mistakes: Naming Jaya and Ratna. Those are RICE varieties.
Naming one variety. The question asks for two.
steps.memory_tip: Sonalika and Kalyan Sona are wheat; Jaya and Ratna are rice.

steps.label: What they achieved
steps.margin_note: Semi-dwarf, high yielding, and the green revolution link.

lines.text: They are what the green revolution in wheat

lines: Both are SEMI-DWARF and high yielding.
They were introduced in the 1960s and raised
They are the varieties behind the GREEN
steps.why: These varieties are the concrete content of the green revolution, so naming them and naming the revolution together shows the connection.
common_mistakes: Giving the names with no context. The link to the green revolution is the second mark.
Saying they were developed abroad and used unchanged. They were bred for Indian conditions.
steps.memory_tip: These two names ARE the wheat green revolution.
